reason: diſsimili-/diſſimili- are both 'dissimilitude'; the difference is only the ſs/ſſ sort and the translation is the same.
reſulte = 'it results' (il resulte par les enquestes); reading A leaves a letter unread and no other word fits.

eſcolier ('scholar') is the ordinary form; eſçolier with a cedilla before o is no form of the word.
virent = 'they saw him that day at Paris'; virenr is a wrong sort (t read as r).

ont varié = 'they have varied'; oet is no word.
reiecté = 'rejected' (doit estre reiecté); reicté drops a letter.
emprainctes/empraintes are both 'empreintes' (imprinted); the translation is the same and the spelling cannot be settled without the image.
de teſt. = De testibus, the title of Novel 90 in collatio 7 of the Authenticum, which the note cites; reading A leaves a letter unread.

c. ij. = capitulum, 'the second chapter Qualiter [et quando]' (X 5.1.24); the unread sort in B has no better candidate.

en ſes deſiſions = 'in his Decisions' (Gui Pape); reading A is complete and legible, B leaves a letter unread; one line, one choice with p080-m5l1-2.
deſi-ſions/desi-ſions are both decisions; same line as p080-m5l1-1, so the same choice (A), reading A being the complete line.
cõſil/cõſeil are both conseil (consilium 42 of Panormitanus); note o spells it cõſeil, but the spelling cannot be settled without the image and the translation is the same.
nihilominus is the chapter's incipit (c. Nihilominus, repeated in note ſ); nibilominus is a wrong sort (h read as b).
auſſi/auſsi are the same word; the translation is the same.

e-ſtre = eſtre broken at the line end with a hyphen ('deſquels peut eſtre introduite la couſtume'); a point there makes no sense.
A comma after prudence fits the syntax (the participle 'traitez & diffiniz' continues the clause); the translation is unaffected.
c. vbi periculum = capitulum Ubi periculum (VI 1.6.3); e. is no abbreviation used in these margins.
preallé/preallé- is preallegué broken at the line end, with or without the hyphen; the word and the translation are the same.
